steps.message:
The `share`/`copyurl` items are now handled only by the video handlers, and the channel menu has its own ids.

## Summary

**Root cause:** Video option menus (grid card popup and both player fragments) first delegate every menu click to `ChannelActionHandler.handleChannelActions(...)`. That handler also claimed `R.id.share` and `R.id.copyurl` — the same ids used by the *video* menus (`video_options_menu.xml`, `menu_youtube_player.xml`). So "Copy URL" on a video was swallowed by the channel handler and copied the channel URL instead of the video URL, and `youTubeVideo.copyUrl()` was never reached.

Secondly, `YouTubeChannel.getChannelUrl()` fed the raw stored `id` into `YoutubeChannelLinkHandlerFactory.getUrl()`. For channels whose id is persisted as a full URL, this produced the doubled address seen in the report: `https://www.youtube.com/https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCKvfz...`.

**Fix:**
1. `channel_options_menu.xml` — renamed the channel-only items to `@+id/share_channel` and `@+id/copy_channel_url`.
2. `ChannelActionHandler` — handles those new channel-specific ids (no longer intercepts the video menu's `share`/`copyurl`), plus a null-channel guard since video cards may have no channel attached.
3. `YouTubeChannel.getChannelUrl()` — normalizes via `getChannelId().getRawId()` (strips a `channel/` prefix/URL) before building the link, so channel URLs are well-formed too.

Result: "Copy URL"/"Share" on a video now yields `https://youtu.be/<videoId>`, while the channel card menu still copies/shares a valid channel URL. `./gradlew clean assembleDebug` builds successfully.
